excerpts: Chained town quests (Gallowmere, Tanner's Fever, Breaking Weir, Advocate's Case)
General quest structure, Wolf-Winter through The Factor's Mark

All 8 quests share an identical skeleton (gather optional bonuses, then a linear gauntlet, then one final choice), and every dangerous check becomes risk-free once the telegraphed NPC bonuses are collected, reducing tension in later chapters.
All follow an identical gather-evidence-then-linear-execute-then-one-choice template, becoming visibly repetitive by the third repetition.
